actions.allowed_actions: GitHub-owned plus explicitly reviewed/pinned third-party actions

collaboration.fork_prs: no secrets; untrusted code only in read-only CI

github-release.protection: optional approval for stable/rc; alpha may use owner approval

merge_queue: NOT_APPLICABLE_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT_BASELINE; do not make alpha prerequisite
packages: GitHub release assets are alpha1 baseline; PyPI is a separate post-alpha gate after namespace/Trusted Publisher prestate
releases: draft -> attach all assets -> immutable prerelease publish -> verify; never publish incomplete immutable release

repository_metadata.description: Plugin-oriented QCAX agent/workflow fabric with tiny trusted host
